title: Greetings
description: Open and close a conversation without sounding like a textbook.

questions.sentence: Nomoskar, apuni kene ase?
questions.correctAnswer: Moi bhal ase, dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Moi bhal ase.
questions.correctAnswer: I am well.

questions.sentence: Tumi kene asa?
questions.correctAnswer: Moi olop bhal ase.
questions.translatedSentence: I am doing okay.

questions.sentence: Apuni kene ase?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you?

questions.sentence: Aji ki khobor?
questions.correctAnswer: Sob thik ase.
questions.translatedSentence: Everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Sob thik ase.
questions.correctAnswer: Everything is fine.

questions.sentence: Moi bhal ase, apuni?
questions.correctAnswer: Moiu bhal ase.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well too.

questions.sentence: Tumi aji bhal ne?
questions.correctAnswer: Are you well today?

questions.sentence: Nomoskar, apunak lag pai bhal lagil.
questions.correctAnswer: Moroo bhal lagil, dhonyobad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am glad to meet you too, thank you.

questions.sentence: Suprabhat! Aji bor bhal din.
questions.correctAnswer: Suprabhat! Hoy, bor bhal din.
questions.translatedSentence: Good morning! Yes, it is a very nice day.

questions.sentence: Puwate moi saah khau.
options: I drink tea in the morning.
I do not drink tea in the morning.
questions.correctAnswer: I drink tea in the morning.

questions.sentence: Moi etiya xubo jau, subha ratri.
questions.correctAnswer: Subha ratri, bhal dore xuo.
questions.translatedSentence: Good night, sleep well.

questions.sentence: Bhal dore xuo, kali dekha hobo.
options: Sleep well, we will meet tomorrow.
Wake up early, we will meet tomorrow.
Sleep well, I will not come tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: Sleep well, we will meet tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Moi apunar ghoroloi aahisu.
questions.correctAnswer: Aahok, bhitoroloi aahok.
questions.translatedSentence: Please come in.

questions.sentence: Aamar ghoroloi apunak xoagotom.
questions.correctAnswer: Welcome to our home.

questions.sentence: Aahok, iyat bohok.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhonyobad, moi bohu.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I will sit down.

questions.sentence: Apuni olop saah khabo ne?
options: Will you have a little tea?
Did you have a little tea?
I will have a little tea.
questions.correctAnswer: Will you have a little tea?

questions.sentence: Puwate apuni ki khai?
questions.correctAnswer: Moi puwate bhat khau.
questions.translatedSentence: I eat rice in the morning.

questions.sentence: Apunar sahajyor babe bohut dhonyobad.
options: Kunu kotha nai, moi eku kora nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Kunu kotha nai, moi eku kora nai.
questions.translatedSentence: Not at all, I did not do anything.

questions.sentence: Bohut dhonyobad, apuni bor sahajyo korile.
options: Thank you very much, you helped a lot.
Thank you very much, I helped you a lot.
Sorry, I could not help you at all.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you very much, you helped a lot.

questions.sentence: Khyoma koribo, moi deri korilu.
questions.correctAnswer: Kunu osubidha nai, iyat bohok.
questions.translatedSentence: No problem at all, please have a seat.

questions.sentence: Moi dukhito, moi bhul korilu.
options: I am sorry, I made a mistake.
I am sorry, I arrived late.
I am happy, I did it correctly.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, I made a mistake.

questions.sentence: Anugroh kori olop rowk.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ase, moi rou.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I will wait.

questions.sentence: Anugroh kori mok olop pani diok.
options: Please give me a little water.
Please give me a little tea.
I do not want any water.
questions.correctAnswer: Please give me a little water.

questions.sentence: Khyoma koribo, moi olop kotha kobo paru ne?
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, apuni kowk.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please go ahead and speak.

questions.sentence: Moi apunak olop sahajyo koribo paru ne?
options: May I help you a little?
Can you help me a little?
I cannot help you at all.
questions.correctAnswer: May I help you a little?

questions.sentence: Khyoma koribo, moi apunar kolomdal olop lobo paru ne?
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, nisoy lowk.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please do take it.

questions.sentence: Moi etiya ghoroloi jau, tente aahim.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ase, bhal dore thakiba.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, take care of yourself.

questions.sentence: Pasot dekha hobo, bhal dore thakibo.
options: We will meet later, take care.
We will not meet later at all.
questions.correctAnswer: We will meet later, take care.

questions.sentence: Kali abelit apunar logot dekha hobo ne?
options: Nai, moi kali puwate saah khalu.
Moi kali apunak dekha pua nai.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, kali abelit dekha hobo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, we will meet tomorrow evening.

questions.sentence: Moi etiya jau, kintu sonkale ghurai aahim.
options: I am leaving now, but I will come back soon.
I am leaving now and I will not come back.
I came back soon after I left.
questions.correctAnswer: I am leaving now, but I will come back soon.

questions.sentence: Bidai! Apunar jatra xubho houk.
questions.correctAnswer: Dhonyobad, moi Jorhatoloi jai aso.
questions.translatedSentence: Thank you, I am on my way to Jorhat.

questions.sentence: Nijor jotno lobo, aru sonkale moloi phone koribo.
options: Take care of yourself, and call me soon.
Take care of yourself, but do not call me.
I will take care of you and call you soon.
questions.correctAnswer: Take care of yourself, and call me soon.

questions.sentence: Aru kitiya apunar logot dekha hobo?
questions.correctAnswer: Aha xoptahot dekha hobo.
questions.translatedSentence: We will meet next week.

questions.sentence: Bohut dhonyobad, tente moi etiya aahim.
options: Thank you very much, I will be off now.
Thank you very much, I will come tomorrow.
Thank you, please do not leave now.
questions.correctAnswer: Thank you very much, I will be off now.

questions.sentence: Tumi kot jai asa?
questions.correctAnswer: Moi bojaroloi jai aso.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the market.

questions.sentence: Aita, apuni kene ase, sorir bhal ase ne?
options: Moi bhal ase, tumi kene asa?
questions.correctAnswer: Moi bhal ase, tumi kene asa?
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, and how are you?

questions.sentence: Moi kokaideur logot xodai xonman kori kotha patu.
options: I always speak respectfully with my elder brother.
I never speak with my elder brother.
My elder brother always speaks respectfully to me.
questions.correctAnswer: I always speak respectfully with my elder brother.

questions.sentence: Koka, apunar babe moi olop saah anim ne?
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, ana, moi saah kham.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, bring it, I will have some tea.

questions.sentence: Apuni bohok, moi thiy hoi thakim.
options: Please sit down, I will remain standing.
Please stand up, I will sit down.
I will sit down and you will remain standing.
questions.correctAnswer: Please sit down, I will remain standing.

questions.sentence: Apunar naam ki, aru apuni kot thake?
options: Mur naam Rupali, moi Jorhatot thako.
questions.correctAnswer: Mur naam Rupali, moi Jorhatot thako.
questions.translatedSentence: My name is Rupali, and I live in Jorhat.

questions.sentence: Ojana manuhor logot xodai apuni buli kobo lage.
options: With someone you do not know you should always use the polite form.
With someone you do not know you should always use the informal form.
With a close friend you should always use the polite form.
questions.correctAnswer: With someone you do not know you should always use the polite form.

questions.sentence: Ma, apuni bhat khaile ne?
options: Hoy, moi etiya bhat khai uthilu.
Nai, eiber moi olop saah khalu.
Moi masor jool bor bhal pau.
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, moi etiya bhat khai uthilu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have just finished my meal.

questions.sentence: Ghorot dangor manuh aahile ami uthi thiy hou.
options: When an elder comes to the house we stand up.
When an elder comes to the house we sit down.
We stand up when we go to an elder's house.
questions.correctAnswer: When an elder comes to the house we stand up.

questions.sentence: Kokaideu, apuni aji amar ghoroloi aahibo ne?
questions.correctAnswer: Hoy, moi abelit aahim.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will come in the evening.

questions.sentence: Kiman dinor pasot apunak dekha palu, apuni kene ase?
options: Moi bhal ase, kintu kamor babe bor byosto asilu.
Khyoma koribo, moi apunak sinaki napalu.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi bhal ase, kintu kamor babe bor byosto asilu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, but I have been very busy with work.

questions.sentence: Moi Guwahatit thakisilu, kintu etiya Jorhatoloi ghuri aahisu.
options: I used to live in Guwahati, but now I have moved back to Jorhat.
I live in Guwahati, but I am going to move to Jorhat.
I used to live in Jorhat, but now I have moved back to Guwahati.
questions.correctAnswer: I used to live in Guwahati, but now I have moved back to Jorhat.

questions.sentence: Apunar poriyalor sokolu kene ase?
options: Sokolu bhal ase, kintu deutar olop oxukh hoise.
Moi kali apunar poriyalok dekha palu.
questions.correctAnswer: Sokolu bhal ase, kintu deutar olop oxukh hoise.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone is well, but my father has been a little unwell.

questions.sentence: Jodi apuni Guwahatiloi aahe, tente amar ghorotei thakibo.
options: If you come to Guwahati, please stay at our house.
If I come to Guwahati, I will stay at your house.
When you came to Guwahati you stayed at our house.
questions.correctAnswer: If you come to Guwahati, please stay at our house.

questions.sentence: Aji abelit saah khaboloi aahok, moi pitha banaisu.
options: Nisoy aahim, kiyono moi apunar pitha bor bhal pau.
questions.correctAnswer: Nisoy aahim, kiyono moi apunar pitha bor bhal pau.
questions.translatedSentence: I will certainly come, because I really like your pitha.

questions.sentence: Moi apunak phone korisilu, kintu apuni phone dhora nasil.
options: I had called you, but you did not pick up.
I will call you, but you will not pick up.
You had called me, but I did not pick up.
questions.correctAnswer: I had called you, but you did not pick up.

questions.sentence: Apuni etiya kot kam kore?
options: Moi etiya saah bagisa ekhonot kam koru.
Moi kam nokoru, kiyono moi ghorote thako.
questions.correctAnswer: Moi etiya saah bagisa ekhonot kam koru.
questions.translatedSentence: I work at a tea garden now.

questions.sentence: Bohut din hol ami logote bohi masor jool khuwa nai.
options: It has been a long time since we sat together and ate fish curry.
We sat together and ate fish curry only a few days ago.
It has been a long time since we cooked fish curry together.
questions.correctAnswer: It has been a long time since we sat together and ate fish curry.

questions.sentence: Tente aha xoptahot amar ghorot bhat khaboloi aahok.
options: Thik ase, jodi somoi pau tente nisoy aahim.
Moi kali apunar ghorot bhat khaisilu.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ase, jodi somoi pau tente nisoy aahim.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, if I get the time I will definitely come.
